result:
Round 8 is a **FAIL**. The Clip Detail panel itself works and passes every acceptance check. The round fails on the timing rule in ┬º8.2: with the panel open and a playing clip selected, per-frame cost goes up and video sync drifts. I logged that as new bug **C-R8-01 (Medium)**. Premium auth is not bypassed.

**Gates (re-run by me):**
- **G8-1:** tsc exit 0; 806/806 tests pass; Biome 0 errors (218 warnings, same as round 7); build passes.
- **G8-2:** protected hashes 4/4 OK and `Header.tsx` matches HEAD. Since round 7, only `StudioWorkspace.tsx` and the one-word `export` in `ArrangementClip.tsx` changed among tracked files.
- **G8-3:** in a fresh browser context with no credentials:
  - `/studio-lab` opens directly and through the header link.
  - The session made no request to `studio-token`, `/api/recording`, `/api/download` or any R2 host.
  - Anonymous `studio-token` returns 401. A fake Bearer gets no token, but the backend is down (500), so that path is only partly checked, as in round 7.
  - `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required".

**What passes:** all named feature IDs (R11-P1b, P1c, P1d, P1e, P4d, U1, R8-D1) and the adjacent checks (R4-M2, RF7-P2, R10-N8/R11A-3, R10-N4, R10-N5, R26-1..3). Highlights from the browser:
- **Resize and collapse:** 36 px Γåö previous height; drag and real Γåæ/Γåô clamp at 120/280. The timeline loses exactly what the panel gains, and nothing goes into the edit history.
- **Gestures and keys:** while the separator is dragged, a second pointer and Mute are refused, and cancel or blur restores the old height. Real Space on the toggle never starts playback; keys typed in the number inputs don't reach shortcuts.
- **Range inputs:** 3.5/7.25 sets the range by button and by Enter, every invalid input shows the exact refusal text, and the multi-select, no-selection and video states are correct.
- **Default state:** open at 144 px at 1440├ù900, collapsed at 1280├ù720, with no load animation. All 4 lanes are visible in both cases.
- **Detail playhead:** moves steadily and is hidden outside the clip.
- **Export:** the WAV after find ΓåÆ add ΓåÆ video ΓåÆ export is identical to round 7: 26.000 s, 1,248,000 frames, silent gap at ΓêÆ240 dB, bass onset at 10.000125 s. The panel's size has no effect on export.

**C-R8-01:** I ran three setups in one session, alternating, at 1440├ù900:

| Setup | Drift result | Per-frame cost, typical / slow frames (ms) |
|---|---|---|
| Panel open, clip selected (the default at 1440) | 3 of 3 valid runs fail (max 0.256 s, 0.174 s, 0.132 s) | 1.4ΓÇô1.5 / 3.3ΓÇô3.8 |
| Panel collapsed, clip selected | 3 of 3 pass | 1.3ΓÇô1.4 / 2.4ΓÇô2.9 |
| Panel open, nothing selected | 2 of 3 pass | 1.3ΓÇô1.4 / 2.8ΓÇô3.0 |

- **Reference:** the limit from round 7 is 1.0 / 1.7 ms. All setups are above it, partly because CPU load was higher today (24ΓÇô34 % vs 14ΓÇô19 %).
- **Panel's own share:** compared with the nothing-selected runs in the same session, the open panel still adds 0.3ΓÇô1.0 ms to slow frames, against a 0.2 ms allowance.
- **Not a script cost:** no long scripts and no forced layout appear, so the extra cost likely comes from drawing the open panel, not from code.
- **Untested cause:** I can't yet tell whether it's the visible waveform or the moving line over it. A cheap probe for A is: panel open, clip selected, playhead parked outside the clip.
- **Small sample:** three runs per setup on a busy headless machine, but the pattern is consistent.

**Blocked:**
- **Writer timing:** A's own run shows one 1.3 ms frame over the 1 ms limit. Re-measuring needs a temporary edit to app source, and I'm read-only, so B has to assign it to A.
- **Guard-revert proof:** reverting the guard to prove the test fails also needs a source edit, so that proof stays A's evidence only.
- **Reduced motion:** the browser tool can't emulate it. I confirmed from the stylesheet that the 300 ms transition only applies when reduced motion is not requested.

**Recommendation for B:**
- **Fix C-R8-01 first.** Put it in round 9 with the other sync bugs (C-R7-01, C-R6-02) and close it before stage 2. Stage 2 is not an independent feature: it changes the same panel and the same height budget.
- **Footer wording:** R11-P1d says "footer is one line". At 1280 the unchanged footer is three lines. Earlier rounds read this as "the shortcut hint is one line", which holds, so the wording should be clarified.
- **Carried items:** the remaining root review and publication-checkpoint findings are listed in the report for B.

**Needs checking:** an untracked file, `store/.claude/agents/frontend-architect.md`, appeared at 19:43:40 during my session. It wasn't there when I started, I didn't create it, and A had finished at 19:33. `.claude/**` is a forbidden path, so root or B should confirm who made it.

I made no app edits, commits or deploys.
